task: Eliminate redundant 'My Team' hierarchy repetition via Entity-Driven Page Header and implement dynamic Institutional Manuscript Template with Title Defense Approval gating and Instructor Management Modal
summary: Resolved the triple vertical repetition of 'My Team' by adopting Option 1 (Entity-Driven Page Header) in TeamsPage.jsx, promoting the active team workspace header to the primary H1 and removing intermediate duplicate banners. Created ManuscriptTemplateWidget with Title Defense Approval access gating (State 1 locked amber banner vs State 2 unlocked emerald banner with Google Docs copy / DOCX download actions). Built InstructorTemplateConfigModal enabling instructors to configure syllabus version, distribution type, and Google Docs copy link or DOCX attachment. Added DocumentTemplate model, server routes GET /api/teams/:id/manuscript-template and PUT /api/teams/manuscript-template, client API methods in teamService, and verified with 100% test pass across 6-point verification battery.
